raw_segments.text: Mr. Bloom, champing, standing, looked upon his sigh.
Will I tell him that horse, Lenihan?
Go and lose more, fool and his money.
Cold knows he'd have kissing a woman, still they might like.
Prickly beards they like, dogs cold noses.
Old Mrs. Reorden with the rumbling stomach sky terrier in the city arms hotel.
Molly fondling him in her lap.
